notes: All 43 candidate songs were checked against this PDF and NONE are present. The candidate list (mostly Kathy Reid-Naiman / library bounce & baby songs matched loosely) does not correspond to the actual content of this Des Plaines Public Library storytime rhymes brochure. The PDF contains 25 distinct rhymes/songs (This Little Piggy, Cheek Chin, Pat a Cake, Oh the Noble Duke of York, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Row Row Row Your Boat, etc.), all transcribed verbatim with their actions. None of these appear in the master missing_lyrics_songs.json, so all are recorded with db_id: null per brief rule 3. Note: 'Tiny Little Babies' is sung to the tune of 'Shortenin' Bread' and 'Little Red Wagon' is from the Wiggleworms Love You album, but these do not correspond to the candidate songs 'Mama's Little Baby loves Shortenin' Bread' (db 209) or any candidate. Page numbering reflects sequential pages 1-3 where song content appears (page 1 also contains intro/resource text).
